from typing import Literal
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

# The case categories provided in the task are safe to model as Literal
CaseCategory = Literal[
    "行政主体 - 房屋拆迁管理（拆迁）",
    "适用特殊程序案件案由",
    "知识产权与竞争",
    "行政行为 - 行政征收",
    "执行案由 - 民事",
    "所有权纠纷",
    "行政行为 - 行政处罚",
    "行政主体 - 劳动和社会保障行政管理（劳动，社会保障）",
    "行政行为 - 行政复议",
    "婚姻家庭纠纷"
]

class DocumentAnalysis(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single judgment document for sorting purposes."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The document title, e.g. '《判决文书1》'")
    case_category: CaseCategory | None = Field(description="The case cause (案由) identified in this document, from the provided list")
    primary_legal_nature: str | None = Field(description="Brief description of the core legal dispute (e.g., 'neighbor dispute', 'administrative penalty')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregate structure for the collection of judgment documents."""
    documents: list[DocumentAnalysis] = Field(description="List of analyzed documents")
